environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF association. Nginx reverse proxy serves /uploads/public/ directory with default MIME type handling (includes executing .php if php-fpm is present, and serving .html/.svg with active content). The upload directory is web-accessible. No file extension filtering at infrastructure level.

config.alb: internet-facing ALB, no WAF WebACL associated
config.php_fpm: installed and configured in nginx for .php extension
config.iam_role: ec2 instance role with S3 and SSM access
